**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Two reviews in one: jenhaert's OpFrame commit (full) and the merge commit's hand fold (delta). Read, built and tested locally (not the runner: outside contributor's code).

## Delta: the fold in `collect_job` (job.rs)
- Main's `setup_wcs_tilt::generation_problem` (#1510) refusal is kept and still runs before any material read (job.rs ~173, before `OpFrame::of(op)` and `material_of`). The tool, `setup_align::generation_problem` and tilt refusals keep their order.
- `OpFrame::material_of` (frame.rs:146) now calls `super::material::judged_material(world, self.setup.as_deref(), src)`. `OpFrame::of(op)` stores `op.setup.clone()`, and `collect_job`'s own `setup` is `op.setup.as_deref()`, so the setup argument is identical to main's call.
- `judged_material` itself is untouched (material.rs:124): `material_of` read, then for any non-`SrcRef::Stock` source the excess is raised to the max with `model_fidelity::excess_of` of the setup's stock entity. So the raw-stock-only mark, per-setup stock, the source and boundary picks and the fallbacks all stay inside the same function main uses.
- The seam's only other change to `collect_job` is the heights read and `checked_frame`, which are the branch's refactor and carry the same error text and order. No other call site reads `OpFrame::material_of`; the other `material_of` callers (area.rs, boundary_ctx.rs, material_region.rs) are main's and unchanged.
- Verdict: the merged material read equals main's for the gouge/collision verdict. I found no path where it judges a different material.

## Full review of the OpFrame commit
- A pure refactor with a decision file (`docs/decisions/763-opframe-seam.md`), provenance lines, no new crate dependency, no new `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in frame.rs, no golden or snapshot change, and `Changelog:` and `Refs #763` in the body. The new code is in `crates/app`, reads the world and the ops, and is placed correctly.
- frame.rs is 440 lines, just over the ~400 guide. A new file, so not blocking. Splitting the math from the world reads would fit.

## Results (locally, merged with main at 67329c86a)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` | builds |
| `opframe_seam` | 8 passed |
| `tool_body_judged` | 8 passed |
| `coarse_laws` | 6 passed |
| `wcs_tilt` | 2 passed |
| `model_fidelity` | 9 passed |
| `setup_align` | 10 passed |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

Not exercised: the ui suites, the rest of the app suites (the PR body says its quick gate was green), the release tier, the pixel snapshots, Windows-vs-Linux arms. The identical-material finding rests on reading the code plus the suites above, not on a differential run of main against the branch.

Questions / notes (not blocking): none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
